Key exchange - share a secret key only both party knows
## Params
$p$ - prime, should be safe ($2q + 1$)
$g$ - generator mod $p$
### Standard params
#### NIST
common values:
p = 
g = 2
## Process
First party chooses a secret $a < p - 1$ and sends $g^a$
Second party chooses a secret $b < p - 1$ and sends $g^b$
Now both know $g^{ab} = (g^a)^b = (g^b)^a$ and only them.
Key is usually derived from hash of the number, in implementation-specific way.
